reference_observations.description: P2-4 diag/ramme markers are broken layout without substantive table/image. P12 changes verbal answer through Frank to postal answer, not a proven later dated section.

Actual table header and columns must survive; trailing 10 belongs to separate non-decimal currency column. Footnote marker is excluded, blank cell retained.
Two-page enclosure is mentioned, but full text absent. Footnote aggregate debit, credit and balance are not an incoming or authorial table to reconstruct.
Next Lady Day is forecast payment timing, not actual receipt; editorial March 24 gloss conflicts with external calendar check. Preserve literal wording and hold normalization.
